parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file passes. It holds a single DTO class, AuthResetPasswordDto, with two string fields: password and hash. The layer model places **/dto/** files in the application layer, and carrying data between layers is what an application DTO is for. The only extra logic is declarative metadata: @IsNotEmpty() checks the input shape and @ApiProperty() documents the field for Swagger. NestJS projects normally put these decorators on DTOs. They are not business rules, persistence, or transport handling. You could argue that @ApiProperty is presentation metadata, but it is tied to the DTO the layer model itself puts in the application layer, so it is not a misplaced responsibility. The file has no service logic, database access, or HTTP handling. No ADR prose was provided to contradict this.
